label: Chance at a source: incidental coincidence, varying set-up, indeterministic propensity
resolution: CHANCE_1 (incidental: a varying concurring condition) and CHANCE_2 (a varying set-up) are both excluded at a source with an invariant set-up (Model.Laws 1 of the will-versus-chance batch); only CHANCE_3 (a non-rational power that gives otherwise from the same set-up) is the chance rival at a simple, patientless source. No argument outside the controls uses a CHANCE sense; the premise-free controls relate all three, and the DNP statements and the willed-holder conclusion are linked here because they are stated as the denial of, or the contrast with, CHANCE_3. No argument passes from one sense to another. The senses are not exclusive: the controls' three-world model has one giver with CHANCE_2 and CHANCE_3 at the same world (SenseModels, clause 5). No coverage of all chance is claimed. Willed two-way giving (choice) is not a sense of chance: it differs from CHANCE_3 only in the Rational classification (flip law).
